The rule: total strength ≥ load = a safe crossing. Maximum spend: 8 coins.
Classroom challenge notes

1. Build a weak bridge and predict the result.
2. Revise your build to carry load 11.
3. Keep the same build and try load 12.
4. Repeat. Does the result change?

20–30 minutes · Discuss which changes affect the result. This is a toy simulation, not real engineering.

Teacher check: steel + wood + wood costs 8 and has strength 11. It passes 11 and fails 12.
